caveat: Lower paired errors are consistency evidence under the declared measurement/operator model; they do not prove exact simulator or physical reversibility.

metric_definitions.paired_actor_mean_consistency_error: pre-decision phase-profile RMSE of raw deterministic actor means
metric_definitions.paired_contact_pattern_error: mean absolute difference of phase-conditioned contact probabilities
metric_definitions.paired_grf_pattern_error: phase-profile RMSE of vertical ground reaction force [N]
metric_definitions.paired_joint_position_error: phase-profile RMSE after the selected operator [rad]
metric_definitions.paired_joint_velocity_error: phase-profile RMSE with temporal odd parity [rad/s]
metric_definitions.paired_normalized_target_consistency_err: pre-decision phase-profile RMSE of unclipped requested targets normalized by soft joint limits
metric_definitions.paired_touchdown_phase_error: symmetric nearest-event circular distance between time-reversed source liftoffs and target touchdowns
metric_definitions.paired_value_consistency_error: pre-decision phase-profile RMSE of critic value predictions
metric_definitions.paired_work_pattern_error: phase-profile RMSE of absolute joint power [W]

operators.front_hind_reflected_temporal_reversal: temporal reversal followed by front-left<->rear-left and front-right<->rear-right reflection; X1 additionally negates reflected thigh/calf coordinates
operators.temporal_reversal: pure temporal reversal; no leg relabeling

phase_alignment.aggregation: interpolate within each covered cycle, then average cycles at each target phase
phase_alignment.policy_timestamp: pre_decision_common_gait_phases for actor mean, unclipped normalized requested target, and value
